findings.why_wrong: Silent agents are invisible agents. If an agent stops communicating, nobody knows whether it's healthy or broken.
findings.suggestion: Check crontab and most recent logs for each silent agent.

findings.title: CIT backlog has 382 open items — proposals not being actioned
findings.observation: data/cit_backlog.json holds 382 entries, 382 open. A backlog this deep means the CIT is generating proposals far faster than the boards act on them — volume without throughput.
findings.why_wrong: A perpetually-growing backlog is the 'useless solutions' failure mode: effort is spent producing proposals nobody implements. Either the proposals lack value or the action path is broken.
findings.suggestion: Triage: sample 20 open BUG_FIX items — if most are low-value/duplicate, raise the CIT confidence/precision gate. If they're valuable, the board action path is the bottleneck — route more to the deputy board for auto-implement. The write site now caps the file at 500.

latest.title: ML / Quantitative: $30,000 capital, zero positions
latest.observation: Pod 'ML / Quantitative' has a $30,000 budget and currently holds $30,000 with zero open positions.
latest.why_wrong: idle capital earns zero return and represents a failure to execute on the pod's mandate.
latest.suggestion: Distinguish the cause, then act: (1) run `python3 ml_pipeline.py` — if it produces picks, this was a pipeline stall, not a policy choice; (2) if it produces nothing and CRO isn't blocking, lower the pod's conviction threshold or widen its watchlist; (3) if the pod is intentionally flat, write the reason and a concrete re-deploy trigger into pod_allocations.json so this stops re-firing.

latest.title: ST model AUC 0.545 — barely above random; weak edge
latest.observation: The model's holdout ensemble AUC is 0.5448 (walk-forward ±0.066) (CV mean 0.5448). That is only marginally better than a coin flip and well below the 0.57 live-trading gate.
latest.why_wrong: A model this weak provides little real edge. Sizing capital to it implies more confidence than the evidence supports.
latest.suggestion: Keep the model out of live buys until AUC clears the gate. Pursue feature expansion / retraining (see model_test_harness.py weekly report) before raising its capital weight.

latest.title: 6 open positions have no review recommendation
latest.observation: state.json shows 6 position(s) that don't appear in review_recommendations.json: ['GS', 'LLY', 'NEE', 'AMAT', 'ENPH']. These positions are unmonitored — no stop-loss or exit signal.
latest.why_wrong: The review agent can only manage positions it knows about. Ghost positions accumulate losses silently with no exit trigger.
latest.suggestion: Reconcile: run review_agent.py manually, or check if positions were opened outside the normal pipeline flow.
